from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792486017/attempts/44ff304bb01845389149adac5e6f0a25/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-a0b76a85.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    rows = len(grid)
    zero_cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 0]
    top = min(r for r, _ in zero_cells)
    bottom = max(r for r, _ in zero_cells)
    left = min(c for _, c in zero_cells)
    right = max(c for _, c in zero_cells)
    return [[grid[rows - r][c] for c in range(left, right + 1)] for r in range(top, bottom + 1)]
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
print(program_path)
